selected_script.angle: Scrubbing baked-on grease on kitchen exterior appliances with an abrasive sponge scratches the finish; Liapu spray gently dissolves the heavy grease so you can wipe it off clean with a soft cloth.
selected_script.hook: I ruined the finish on my last toaster oven by scrubbing the grease with a rough sponge.

script_record.segment_01: I ruined the finish on my last toaster oven by scrubbing the grease with a rough sponge. Now I just use this Liapu degreaser instead.
script_record.segment_02: You literally just spray it on the heavy buildup, wait a few seconds, and wipe it away with a soft cloth. It cuts right through it.
script_record.segment_03: It leaves zero harsh residue, smells like fresh lemon, and kills 99.9% of bacteria. Definitely a kitchen essential.
